channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Endeavor Catalyst Secures $320M to Fund Entrepreneurs Outside Silicon Valley
item.description: Endeavor Catalyst collected $320 million to support business founders located outside major hubs. A portion of the earnings will return to the nonprofit organization that discovers these entrepreneurs.

item.title: সৌদি আরবের দুটি বিমানবন্দরে হামলায় তিন বিদেশি নিহত ও ৩৬ জন আহত
item.description: রিয়াদের কিং খালিদ এবং দক্ষিণাঞ্চলের আবহা আন্তর্জাতিক বিমানবন্দরে হামলার ঘটনা ঘটে। এতে এক নারীসহ তিনজন বিদেশি নাগরিক নিহত এবং ৩৬ জন আহত হয়েছেন।

item.title: Tui River Cruise Guests Frustrated After Bus Tours Replace Itinerary
item.description: Travellers expressed frustration after their river cruise schedules were altered. Instead of the planned trip, participants spent hours travelling by bus.

item.title: Hedgehog and Three Other Animals Selected for New Banknote Designs
item.description: Following a public vote involving nearly 500,000 participants from an initial list of 18 species, the hedgehog has been chosen to appear on upcoming banknotes alongside three other animals.

item.title: LSE Chief Urges Greater Incentives to Keep Major Companies in the UK
item.description: London Stock Exchange CEO Dame Julia Hoggett argues that British citizens require additional incentives to support large domestic corporations and prevent them from relocating.

item.title: Delhi High Court Directs Centre to Review Plea for Police Body Cameras
item.description: The court addressed a public interest litigation filed by advocate Chahat Raghav. The petition requests an expert committee to establish mandatory guidelines for continuous police body camera use during protests.

item.title: Rivian Introduces Mobile Lockscreen Pet Camera Feature for R2 Vehicles
item.description: Drivers of Rivian R2 vehicles can now stream live footage of their pets directly to their smartphone lockscreens while away from the automobile.

item.title: Rio de Janeiro Protesters March Against Flavio Bolsonaro's Presidential Bid
item.description: Crowds of students and demonstrators gathered in Rio to protest after Flavio Bolsonaro advanced to the Brazilian presidential runoff election.

item.title: Mamata Banerjee travels to Delhi amid talks for presidential visit
item.description: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee reached Delhi while opposition parties wait for the president to schedule a meeting between October 7 and 9. The delegation size for the proposed appointment has been restricted.

item.title: Arsenal midfielder Declan Rice nearing extension
item.description: Midfielder Declan Rice is nearing an agreement on an extended contract with Arsenal, according to insider reports from BBC Sport.

item.title: Central government challenges Jharkhand DGP selection
item.description: The Supreme Court will examine a central government petition to invalidate Tadasha Mishra's selection as Jharkhand's police chief. Officials argue the appointment violates guidelines established by a 2006 Supreme Court ruling.

item.title: Chicago council approves massive housing project for empty lot
item.description: Chicago authorities cleared a housing project for the LeClaire Courts property. The first stage includes two six-story structures with 183 residential units and a daycare center, where most apartments are designated as affordable.

item.title: CBI dossier includes messaging data in Punjab bribery probe
item.description: Investigators reviewing corruption allegations involving Punjab officials have incorporated WhatsApp messages into their files. The material is part of the CBI's preparations to question Rajbir Singh Ghuman, an OSD to the chief minister.

item.title: Tennessee court directs preservation of execution material
item.description: A Nashville magistrate instructed state administrators to retain physical materials related to the unsuccessful execution procedure of Christa Pike.

item.title: Actress Sandra Bullock sells California avocado ranch
item.description: Actress Sandra Bullock parted with her 91-acre California estate, featuring an organic avocado farm, for $5.6 million. She originally purchased the Valley Center property in 2007 for $2.725 million and subsequently renovated it.

item.title: Supreme Court to review contempt petition over Jharkhand DGP selection
item.description: A bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant will examine a contempt plea filed by the Union government regarding Tadasha Mishra's appointment as Jharkhand's police chief. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta requested the court to schedule the hearing for this matter.

item.title: Elderly Spanish woman passes away following high-profile eviction
item.description: Eighty-seven-year-old Maricarmen Abascal has passed away, labor organizers announced. She previously gained national attention when police carried her out on a stretcher from her home of seven decades in September.

item.title: Medical Expenses Highest for Rural and Urban Travelers
item.description: Over a one-year timeframe, healthcare travel emerged as the costliest journey type in both city and countryside regions. City dwellers faced significantly steeper medical travel costs, while pilgrimage journeys made up the bulk of total travel volume.

item.title: BMW Introduces iX4 Electric SUV Amid Market Shifts
item.description: BMW has launched the iX4 electric vehicle, offering a 428-mile range as global competition intensifies. The new SUV aims to attract buyers through advanced technology, competitive pricing, and strong driving performance.

item.title: বেলজিয়ামে শিক্ষার্থীদের বিক্ষোভ, আটক ১০৭
item.description: শিক্ষাব্যবস্থায় বর্ধিত খরচ, অতিরিক্ত শিক্ষার্থীর চাপ এবং উপকরণের সংকটের প্রতিবাদে বেলজিয়ামের ফরাসিভাষী অঞ্চলে শিক্ষার্থীরা আন্দোলন করছেন। এই বিক্ষোভের সময় মোট ১০৭ জনকে আটক করা হয়েছে।

item.title: India and Canada Advance Trade Pact Ahead of Modi Visit
item.description: India and Canada are holding their fifth round of negotiations for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. Both nations hope to finalize the trade deal during Prime Minister Modi's planned trip to Canada in December.

item.title: Rubio Promotes Trump Foreign Policy During Greece Visit
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio visited Greece to advocate for Donald Trump's America First agenda. Speaking near the Parthenon, he encouraged European nations to alter their current foreign policy posture.

item.title: London Students Hold Pro-Palestine March on October 7
item.description: University student groups organized a pro-Palestine street demonstration in London on October 7. The march proceeded despite prior requests from police forces to delay the event.

item.title: Trump Expresses Desire for Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: US President Trump stated he believes he should receive the Nobel Peace Prize. He has frequently mentioned deserving the honor since returning to the White House.

item.title: DNC Files Lawsuit Over Government-Funded Trump Ads
item.description: The Democratic National Committee filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration on Wednesday. The legal action challenges government-funded television advertisements promoting the president, labeling them unlawful propaganda.

item.title: Trump Discusses Nobel Peace Prize Perceptions
item.description: Donald Trump stated that the Nobel Peace Prize committee would face significant criticism if they failed to honor him. The former US president shared his perspective on why he believes he merits the international accolade.

item.title: Legal Dispute Over NDA Between Jolie and Pitt
item.description: Angelina Jolie's legal representative accused Brad Pitt of trying to enforce a non-disclosure agreement and demanding financial documents. A judge ruled that Pitt failed to justify the need for records spanning 2017 to 2019.

item.title: Cornell University Students Protest Sexual Assault Response
item.description: Students at Cornell University organized a sit-in inside a campus dining hall. Participants also pledged a spending boycott to protest sexual violence and the institution's response to misconduct reports.

item.title: Assessing Israel Three Years After October 7
item.description: Observers analyze the trajectory of Israel three years following the historic bloodshed of October 2023. Despite early predictions of his downfall, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu remains in power.

item.title: Lululemon Appoints Former Athleta Leader as Product Chief
item.description: Lululemon named Maggie Gauger, previously the CEO of Athleta, as its new chief product officer. The appointment fills a newly established executive position at the athletic apparel firm.

item.title: Family Disputes Assam Government Claims on Deported Woman
item.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Sarma stated a deported woman is safe in Bangladesh, but her son disputes this as she remains missing. The family seeks official help while the Gauhati High Court monitors the situation.

item.title: South Africa and Australia Meet in Test Cricket Series
item.description: South Africa is hosting Australia for Test matches, marking their first red-ball encounter since the 2018 ball-tampering controversy. Australia enters the series following recent struggles against Bangladesh.

item.title: Reflecting on Harmanpreet Kaur's Impact on Indian Cricket
item.description: Harmanpreet Kaur transformed the playing style of India's women's cricket team through exceptional performances. Her leadership eventually guided the squad to secure its maiden world championship title.

item.title: Teenage Engineering plans to halt synthesizer production
item.description: Jesper Kouthoofd, head of Teenage Engineering, announced that the firm will discontinue its synthesizer line, which features the well-known OP-1 device. Beyond music hardware, the company operates as a design agency.

item.title: Sean Diddy Combs ordered to pay legal fees in defamation suit
item.description: Following the dismissal of his $100 million defamation case against NBCUniversal regarding a Peacock documentary, Sean Diddy Combs must pay $477,700 in legal costs. The network originally requested nearly $1 million.

item.title: Autoimmune illness develops in Gaza child during conflict
item.description: A young resident of Gaza has developed an autoimmune disorder during the ongoing military conflict involving Israel.

item.title: Rio de Janeiro protests target Flavio Bolsonaro
item.description: On Wednesday, numerous individuals participated in a student demonstration in central Rio de Janeiro to oppose Flavio Bolsonaro prior to the October 25 presidential runoff. Protesters mobilized following his first-round lead.

item.title: RBI raises repo rate by 25 basis points
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India increased its repo rate to 5.5% in response to rising inflation and stronger economic growth. This adjustment will increase monthly loan payments for borrowers.

item.title: FCC plans mid-band auction and drone spectrum access
item.description: The regulatory commission has suggested holding a fresh mid-band spectrum auction and making the 800MHz frequency available for drone operations. The initiative also emphasizes direct-to-device connectivity.

item.title: Levi Strauss raises profit forecast following tariff refunds
item.description: Levi Strauss reported better-than-expected earnings on Wednesday, aided by financial returns from tariffs. However, the company maintained a more cautious perspective regarding future sales.

item.title: যুক্তরাজ্যে ভুয়া সমকামী সাজিয়ে আশ্রয় আবেদন করায় গ্রেপ্তার ৩
item.description: যুক্তরাজ্যে ভুয়া সমকামী পরিচয়ে বাংলাদেশিদের রাজনৈতিক আশ্রয়ের আবেদন তৈরি করে দেওয়ার অভিযোগে তিনজনকে গ্রেপ্তার করা হয়েছে। এই চক্রটি দেশে জীবন বিপন্ন হওয়ার মিথ্যা দাবি তুলে বহু আবেদন জমা দিয়েছিল।

item.title: SpaceX Unveils Design Concepts for Orbiting AI Facilities
item.description: SpaceX has revealed its updated vision for establishing artificial intelligence data centers in space. The initiative focuses on deploying advanced computing infrastructure directly into orbit.

item.title: Israel Commemorates Three-Year Mark of October 7 Attacks
item.description: On Wednesday, Israel observed the third anniversary of the October 7 Hamas attacks through quiet memorials at the Nova festival venue and Kfar Aza kibbutz. The day also involved ongoing military strikes in Gaza alongside rising political discussions ahead of upcoming elections.

item.title: Trump Asserts Iran's Nuclear Capabilities Have Been Eliminated
item.description: US President Donald Trump stated that the conflict with Iran will conclude rapidly and predicted falling oil costs. He also maintained that American actions have stripped Tehran of its nuclear capabilities.

item.title: Spanish Housing Rights Figure Maricarmen Abascal Passes Away
item.description: Maricarmen Abascal, an 80-year-old Spanish woman who became a symbol of national housing protests, has died in the hospital. She had been hospitalized following her forcible removal by stretcher from her residence of over 70 years on September 23.

item.title: ডিপি ওয়ার্ল্ডের সঙ্গে দীর্ঘ প্রতীক্ষিত চুক্তি আজ স্বাক্ষরিত হচ্ছে
item.description: ২০০৭ সালে নির্মিত নিউমুরিং টার্মিনালে একসঙ্গে চারটি বড় ও একটি ছোট কনটেইনার জাহাজ ভেড়ানোর সুবিধা রয়েছে। দীর্ঘ প্রক্রিয়া শেষে আজ এই বন্দর টার্মিনাল পরিচালনার জন্য ডিপি ওয়ার্ল্ডের সঙ্গে চুক্তি সম্পন্ন হতে যাচ্ছে।

item.title: CUET-UG 2027 Exam May Introduce Simplified Format
item.description: The CUET-UG 2027 entrance tests are considering major reforms to ease the testing process for applicants. Proposed adjustments involve cutting test subjects from five to four and decreasing individual paper lengths.

item.title: Nous Research Reaches $1.5B Valuation and Releases AI Agents
item.description: The creator of the Hermes Agent secured a $90 million Series B funding round. This milestone brings the firm's overall valuation to $1.5 billion alongside the rollout of new enterprise artificial intelligence tools.

item.title: Premier League Transfer Rumours Involve United and Liverpool
item.description: Manchester United and Liverpool are reportedly monitoring Adrien Truffert. Meanwhile, Newcastle is pursuing Tyler Morton, and Martin Odegaard is expected to secure a contract extension with Arsenal.

item.title: Jon Rahm's legal counsel announces departure from LIV Golf
item.description: Jon Rahm is exiting LIV Golf after rejecting the conditions of LIV 2.0 as unsatisfactory. This development was disclosed by his legal representative during a bankruptcy court proceeding.

item.title: ইউএইর পক্ষ থেকে বাজেয়াপ্ত করা শেয়ারের আপিল দ্রুত নিষ্পত্তির তাগিদ
item.description: বাংলাদেশে কিছু প্রতিষ্ঠানে অবৈধভাবে স্থানান্তরিত অর্থ বিনিয়োগের ঘটনায় জব্দকৃত শেয়ার সংক্রান্ত আপিল মামলা দ্রুত শুনানি শেষ করার আবেদন জানিয়েছে সংযুক্ত আরব আমিরাত।

item.title: টেনেসি রাজ্যে ব্যর্থ মৃত্যুদণ্ড কার্যকরের ঘটনায় ক্রিস্টা পাইকের ক্ষোভ
item.description: ব্যর্থ মৃত্যুদণ্ড প্রচেষ্টার বিষয়টি গভীরভাবে টের পেয়েছেন ক্রিস্টা পাইক, জানিয়েছেন তার আইনজীবীরা। এই ত্রুটিপূর্ণ ঘটনার সমস্ত প্রমাণ সুরক্ষিত রাখতে রাজ্য কর্তৃপক্ষকে নির্দেশ দিয়েছেন একজন বিচারক।

item.title: বার্লিন ম্যারাথনে বাইক চড়ায় স্পন্সরের বাদ পড়া চীনা প্রতিযোগী
item.description: বার্লিন ম্যারাথনের নির্দিষ্ট অংশে অন্য একজনের বাইকের পেছনে চড়ার দৃশ্য ধারণ হওয়ার পর সুন ইউয়ানুয়ানকে তার পৃষ্ঠপোষক প্রতিষ্ঠান বাদ দিয়েছে।

item.title: আবাসন সংকটের প্রতীক স্পেনের মারিয়া দেল কারমেন আবাসকাল ৮৭ বছর বয়সে প্রয়াত
item.description: মাদ্রিদে দীর্ঘ সাত দশকেরও বেশি সময় বসবাস করা ফ্ল্যাট থেকে মারিকর্মেনের উচ্ছেদাদেশ স্পেনে আবাসন সংকটবিরোধী বিক্ষোভের সূত্রপাত ঘটিয়েছিল। ৮৭ বছর বয়সে এই নারী মারা গেছেন।

item.title: হামাসের হামলার তিন বছর পূর্তিতে ইসরায়েলে নিহতদের স্মরণ
item.description: হামাস পরিচালিত সেই মারাত্মক হামলার তৃতীয় বার্ষিকীতে ইসরায়েলে স্মরণানুষ্ঠান আয়োজিত হয়েছে, যা পরবর্তীতে ধ্বংসাত্মক গাজা যুদ্ধের সূচনা করেছিল।

item.title: প্রধান নির্বাচন কমিশনারের পদত্যাগের দাবিতে বিরোধীদের প্রতিবাদ
item.description: সিইসি জ্ঞানেশ কুমারের পদত্যাগ দাবিতে বিরোধীদের বিক্ষোভের সময় দিল্লি পুলিশ তাদের আটক করে। যন্তর মন্তরের কাছে এই প্রতিবাদ কর্মসূচিতে বিরোধী জোটের সদস্যরা অংশ নেন।

item.title: Contrasting Paths for Messi and Ronaldo's Careers
item.description: BBC Sport examines the final phase of international football for two legends. While Lionel Messi concludes his national team journey warmly, Cristiano Ronaldo faces an uncertain exit.

item.title: নিউগিনি প্রপার্টিজে হামলা মামলায় আসামিদের কারাগারে ও রিমান্ডে প্রেরণ
item.description: রাজধানীর নিউগিনি প্রপার্টিজে ভাঙচুর ও লুটের মামলায় তিন অভিযুক্তকে কারাগারে পাঠানো হয়েছে এবং অন্য তিনজনকে রিমান্ডে নেওয়া হয়েছে। এই সহিংসতায় ব্যাপক ক্ষয়ক্ষতি হয়েছে এবং বেশ কয়েকজনকে গ্রেপ্তার করা হয়েছে।

item.title: গুগলবুকসে অ্যান্ড্রয়েডের ফিজিক্যাল নেভিগেশন বোতামের প্রত্যাবর্তন
item.description: গুগলবুকসে কুইক ইনসার্ট এবং গুগল লোগো কি নতুন কোনো সংযোজন নয়, কারণ এগুলো অতীতেও আত্মপ্রকাশ করেছিল। তবে ডিভাইসটিতে ঐতিহ্যবাহী ফিজিক্যাল নেভিগেশন বোতামের মতো উপাদান ফিরে এসেছে।

item.title: WHO seeks Russian data on suspected Siberian plague fatality
item.description: The World Health Organization requested additional details from Russia on Wednesday regarding the death of a Siberian laboratory worker suspected of having pneumonic plague.
